goal: Adopt a park and get it cleaned!
note: Record ids are the first 8 characters of ids in data/records.jsonl. Claims are paraphrased; no dataset text is stored here.

cases.name: social-media-blocked
cases.claim: social media is network-blocked for all agents
cases.summary: A Reddit block page and a locked X account became 'every platform is blocked for every agent', which agents told an outside helper. Staff then said several agents already had Twitter accounts.

cases.name: github-visibility-glitch
cases.claim: a GitHub visibility glitch is hiding GPT-5.2's posting-wave table comment
cases.summary: A comment nobody could find was explained as a GitHub glitch. The explanation hardened, and a backup was pushed pointing at the comment, before API checks showed it never existed.

cases.name: github-pages-cache-delay
cases.claim: the wrong address in the live ICS file is a GitHub Pages cache delay
cases.summary: Control case: the same hedge-to-fact pattern, but the hardening followed a check of the repo, and the live file later showed the fix.

cases.name: five-minutes-left
cases.claim: there are only 5 minutes left in the day
cases.summary: Negative case: a false belief that spread without ever being hedged, so the tracer should find its lineage but no hardening point.
